how_it_works: Fraudsters send fake links to steal personal or banking information.
warning_signs: Unknown links and urgent messages.
precautions: Do not click unknown links.

how_it_works: Fraudsters call pretending to be bank officials.
warning_signs: Requests for OTP, PIN, or passwords.
precautions: Never share OTP or PIN.

how_it_works: Scammers offer fake products or request advance payments.
warning_signs: Very low prices and suspicious sellers.
precautions: Verify sellers and use trusted payment methods.

how_it_works: Scammers promise credit card fee waivers to obtain banking details.
warning_signs: Requests for card details or OTP.
precautions: Contact your bank using its official number.

how_it_works: Fraudsters use devices to copy card information.
warning_signs: Suspicious attachments or loose ATM parts.
precautions: Inspect the ATM and cover your PIN.

how_it_works: Scammers convince victims to install screen-sharing applications.
warning_signs: Requests to share your screen during banking.
precautions: Never share your screen with unknown callers.

how_it_works: Fraudsters obtain a duplicate SIM to receive OTPs.
warning_signs: Unexpected loss of mobile network.
precautions: Contact your mobile operator immediately.

how_it_works: Scammers publish fake customer support numbers online.
warning_signs: Unofficial contact numbers and payment requests.
precautions: Use contact details from official websites.

how_it_works: Fraudsters trick victims into scanning QR codes to make payments.
warning_signs: Requests to scan QR codes to receive money.
precautions: You generally do not need to scan a QR code to receive money.

how_it_works: Scammers create fake profiles using another person's identity.
warning_signs: Duplicate accounts asking for money.
precautions: Verify the person's identity before sending money.

how_it_works: A compromised charging port may attempt data theft or malware installation.
warning_signs: Unknown or untrusted USB charging stations.
precautions: Use your own charger or a power bank.

how_it_works: Scammers claim that victims have won a lottery and demand fees.
warning_signs: Unexpected prize messages and advance fee requests.
precautions: Do not pay money to claim unknown prizes.

how_it_works: Fake recruiters demand registration or training fees.
warning_signs: Guaranteed jobs with upfront payments.
precautions: Verify the employer before paying any fee.

how_it_works: A fake agent at a stall collects insurance payment into a personal account.
warning_signs: Payment asked into a personal account and no official receipt.
precautions: Buy policies only from authorised offices and verify the account.

how_it_works: A fake email asks you to click a link, open an attachment or send money.
warning_signs: Odd sender address, urgent tone and unexpected attachments.
precautions: Check the sender and do not open unknown attachments.

how_it_works: A fraudster poses as the bank on a messaging app and collects your details.
warning_signs: Unknown number claiming to be a bank and asking for codes.
precautions: Banks do not handle banking requests on messaging apps. Block and report.

how_it_works: Your shared documents are misused to take a loan in your name.
warning_signs: Recovery calls for a loan you never took.
precautions: Share document copies carefully and check your credit report.

how_it_works: Betting sites promise quick gains, then demand more deposits and block withdrawals.
warning_signs: Guaranteed returns and extra deposits needed to withdraw.
precautions: Avoid unlicensed betting sites.

how_it_works: A caller offers a vaccine slot and asks for your OTP.
warning_signs: Unexpected vaccination call asking for OTP.
precautions: Register only on the official portal and never share OTP.

how_it_works: A fake site takes payment and details for a test that never happens.
warning_signs: Unknown site and payment asked through a link.
precautions: Book only on official hospital or lab sites.
